name: AP7361C-33E-13
title: AP7361C: 1 A low-dropout regulator, fixed or adjustable output, with enable
summary: A linear regulator for up to 1 A from a 2.2 V to 6.0 V supply, with low dropout (340 mV typical at 1 A for 2.6 V to 3.3 V outputs) and 60 µA quiescent current. Fixed versions are set from 1.0 V to 3.3 V; the adjustable version runs from 0.8 V to 5.0 V with two resistors. It has an active-high enable on most packages, current limiting with fold-back into a short, and thermal shutdown, and is stable with 2.2 µF or more of ceramic at the output. AP7361C-33E-13 is the fixed 3.3 V part in SOT223, which has no enable pin.
key_figures: 2.2 V to 6.0 V (6.5 V absolute maximum)
90 mV typ (140 mV max) at 300 mA; 340 mV typ at 1 A
75 dB at 1 kHz, 55 dB at 10 kHz (100 mA)
1.5 A typ, 1.1 A min; short-circuit 400 mA

notes: Order code: AP7361C-, then the output code (blank for adjustable; 10, 12, 15, 18, 25, 28, 33 for 1.0 V to 3.3 V), then the package code (FGE, Y5, D, DR, E, ER, SP, SPR), then the reel code (-7 for a 7-inch reel, -13 for a 13-inch reel).
AP7361C-33E-13 is the fixed 3.3 V part in SOT223 on a 13-inch reel of 2500, with no EN pin; its marking reads 61-33 under the logo with a YWX date line.
The R packages (SOT223R, TO252 (DPAK)R, SO-8EPR) carry the same die with a different pin order.
Adjustable versions are listed for U-DFN3030-8 (Type E), SOT89-5 and SO-8EPR, the packages with an ADJ/NC pin. SOT223 and TO252 (DPAK) have no EN pin.

Date code on the small packages: Y is the year digit (0 to 9); W is the week, A to Z for weeks 1 to 26 and a to z for weeks 27 to 52, with z also used for week 53; X is an internal code. TO252 and SO-8EP use YY for the year and WW for the week (01 to 52, 52 also covering week 53), then an internal code XX. The SO-8EP and SO-8EPR date line ends in E.
Pin 1 of the marked SOT223 and TO252 (DPAK) is IN, pin 2 GND, pin 3 OUT; on the R versions pin 1 is GND, pin 2 OUT, pin 3 IN.

circuits.title: Fixed version with EN
circuits.description: A fixed-output part with its enable pin brought out. A 4.7 µF capacitor sits from IN to ground and another 4.7 µF from OUT to ground; an external logic signal drives EN to switch the output on and off.

circuits.title: Adjustable output
circuits.description: The adjustable part. R1 runs from OUT to ADJ and R2 from ADJ to ground, so the output settles where ADJ equals the 0.8 V reference: VOUT = 0.8 V × (1 + R1/R2). CIN and COUT, 4.7 µF each, decouple input and output; EN is driven from outside.

parts.note: upper divider resistor; sets VOUT with R2

notes: R1 and R2 are set by the output-voltage equation.

circuits.title: Fixed version without EN

circuits.title: Adjustable output, 1 µF input

where.RθJA: junction-to-ambient thermal resistance of the package on its board

operation.text: A gate driver controls the pass element between IN and OUT. An error amplifier compares a 0.8 V reference with the feedback node: on fixed versions an internal pair of resistors from OUT to GND feeds it, on the adjustable version the ADJ pin does. A current-limit and thermal-shutdown block acts on the driver. EN switches the driver on the versions that have it; the version without EN has no such input.

EN high turns the output on and EN low turns it off. EN reads low at 0.3 V or less and high from 1.0 V up to VIN; a 3.0 MΩ pull-down holds it low when undriven. Without the feature, EN is tied to IN. The drive must swing past both thresholds. SOT223 and TO252 (DPAK) have no EN pin. Shut down, the part draws 0.05 µA typical, 1 µA at most. The output has a 100 Ω discharge resistor (VOL = 1 V).

IN wants at least 1 µF of ceramic to GND, mounted next to the part with wide IN and GND copper, to keep supply glitches and noise out; there is no upper limit on this capacitance. How much is needed depends on ESR: a low-ESR part can be smaller, a high-ESR part has to be larger.

The output needs a capacitor for stability and transient response; 2.2 µF or more of ceramic keeps it stable, and MLCC, aluminium electrolytic, tantalum or solid types of 2.2 µF or more are all accepted. More capacitance lowers undershoot and overshoot on line and load steps. The capacitor sits close to OUT and GND. Ceramic is preferred, though other low-ESR types work: across 0 to 1 A and -40 °C to +85 °C the stable region runs from 0 to 10 Ω ESR (measured over 10 Hz to 2 MHz).

Fixed versions come set to 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2.5, 2.8 or 3.3 V with ±1% accuracy from 1.5 V up (±15 mV below 1.5 V). The adjustable version covers 0.8 V to 5.0 V with an external divider from OUT through ADJ to GND, referred to 0.8 V (0.792 V to 0.808 V); ADJ leakage is 0.1 µA typical, 0.5 µA at most. No minimum load is needed beyond the divider itself; the output stays regulated with no load.

Above the current-limit threshold (1.1 A minimum, 1.5 A typical) the output current is clamped. With OUT shorted to ground, fold-back cuts the current to about 400 mA; full current returns once the output rises above 15% of its set voltage. Both protect the part from overheating.

The output is switched off when the junction reaches about +150 °C and back on when it has cooled to about +130 °C (20 °C hysteresis). Under sustained overload the output can cycle on and off, which caps the heat in the part.

After EN goes high the regulator delivers full power about 200 µs later (typical). The specified start-up time is 150 µs typical with VOUT = 3 V, COUT = 2.2 µF and a 30 Ω load. Quiescent current stays around 60 µA across the input range (80 µA maximum).

Dissipation is the input-output difference times the load current. What the package can handle depends on θJA, the highest ambient temperature and the +150 °C junction limit, so the copper area tied to the thermal pad matters for avoiding thermal shutdown.
For outputs of 2.6 V to 3.3 V, dropout is 90 mV typical (140 mV maximum) at 300 mA and 340 mV typical at 1 A. A 3.3 V output also carries a dropout figure of 360 mV typical at 1 A.

Packages: U-DFN3030-8 (Type E), SOT89-5, SOT223, TO252 (DPAK) and SO-8EP, with reversed-pin R variants of SOT223, TO252 and SO-8EP. Leads are matte tin on SOT89-5, SOT223, SO-8EP and TO252, and NiPdAu over copper on U-DFN3030-8, solderable per MIL-STD-202 Method 208. Approximate weights: U-DFN3030-8 0.017 g, SOT89-5 0.059 g, SOT223 0.113 g, SO-8EP 0.081 g, TO252 0.33 g. Moisture sensitivity level 1 per J-STD-020. Lead-free, RoHS compliant, halogen- and antimony-free green molding compound. Ambient range -40 °C to +85 °C.
LCD TVs and monitors, set-top boxes and home appliances; also low-to-medium power uses such as laptops, audio and video equipment and battery-powered devices.
